name: New domain proposal

labels: new-domain
---

Adding projects to an *existing* map only needs a PR (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) — CI checks it automatically.
A whole **new domain** gets a quick sanity check here first, so we don't
end up with ten overlapping half-finished maps. This is a short form, not
a gate — most reasonable proposals get a quick 👍 within a few days.

**Domain name & one-line description**

<!-- e.g. "Game Development — engines, asset pipelines, netcode, and more." -->

**Rough category breakdown**

<!-- The 5-8 top-level categories you'd expect this map to have, e.g.
     "Engines, Asset Pipelines, Netcode, Physics, Tooling" -->

**Why this domain, why now**

<!-- What makes it a good fit alongside the existing maps (AI, Data
     Science, Databases, DevOps, Mobile, Security, Web Dev)? Roughly how
     many projects do you expect to curate for it (existing maps run
     ~45-55 projects each)? -->

**Are you planning to submit the data yourself?**

<!-- Yes/no. If not, that's fine — this can sit open for someone else to
     pick up, but a proposal with no one attached to it moves slower. -->
